prompt: In the town where the most successful American Ace of World War 2 to survive that war was born, there is a college. What was the name and percentage of the largest demographic of full and part time students attending that college in 2020?
answer:
The ace was **David McCampbell**, the highest-scoring American ace to survive World War II, who was born in **Bessemer, Alabama**. The college there is **Lawson State Community College**.

In fall 2020, the largest demographic at Lawson State was **Black or African American students**—approximately **90% of full-time students and 87% of part-time students**.
